items.title: Strip location data from uploaded originals

checks.command: KASVIMUSEO_IMAGE=kasvimuseo-dev-task24 nix-shell -p postgresql --run 'dev/kasvimuseo app build && dev/kasvimuseo app test'
KASVIMUSEO_IMAGE=kasvimuseo-dev-task24 KASVIMUSEO_BROWSER_ENGINES=chromium nix-shell -p postgresql --run 'dev/kasvimuseo app build && dev/kasvimuseo app browser-test'

KASVIMUSEO_IMAGE=kasvimuseo-dev-task24 nix-shell -p postgresql --run 'dev/kasvimuseo app build' >/dev/null
set -euo pipefail
for link in .dev media static ylaneenkasvit/local_settings.py; do test ! -L "$link"; done
export KASVIMUSEO_IMAGE=kasvimuseo-dev-task24 KASVIMUSEO_DB_NAME=kasvimuseo_task24_count
work=$(mktemp -d)
cat > "$work/check.sh" <<'SH'
set -euo pipefail
trap 'dev/kasvimuseo db stop >/dev/null' EXIT
dev/kasvimuseo db start >/dev/null
psql -h "$PWD/.dev/run" -p 5432 -U "$USER" -d postgres -q -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $KASVIMUSEO_DB_NAME" -c "CREATE DATABASE $KASVIMUSEO_DB_NAME OWNER ylaneenkasvit"
rm -rf media/photologue
dev/kasvimuseo db bootstrap >/dev/null
dev/kasvimuseo app manage shell <<'PY'
from django.db.models.signals import pre_save
from photologue.models import Photo
from kasvimuseo.models import turn_photo_upright
from kasvimuseo.tests.test_photo_orientation import save_photo, tagged_image_bytes
assert pre_save.disconnect(turn_photo_upright, sender=Photo)
save_photo(tagged_image_bytes(private=True))
save_photo(tagged_image_bytes(1), title='tarhapioni kukassa')
PY
before=$(sha256sum media/photologue/photos/*.jpg)
counted=$(dev/kasvimuseo app manage strip_private_exif --count)
echo "count: $counted"
test "$counted" = '1 of 2 originals have private tags.'
test "$(sha256sum media/photologue/photos/*.jpg)" = "$before"
echo 'count mode changed no original'
stripped=$(dev/kasvimuseo app manage strip_private_exif)
echo "strip: $stripped"
test "$stripped" = 'Removed the private tags from 1 of 2 originals.'
recounted=$(dev/kasvimuseo app manage strip_private_exif --count)
echo "count again: $recounted"
test "$recounted" = '0 of 2 originals have private tags.'
rm -rf media/photologue
SH
nix-shell -p postgresql --run "bash $work/check.sh"
rm -rf "$work"
echo ok

! grep -rnF 'image.url' kasvimuseo/templates/kasvimuseo kasvimuseo/templates/photologue && grep -qF '<a href="{{ object.get_display_url }}">' kasvimuseo/templates/photologue/photo_detail.html && echo ok

test "$(git diff --name-only 7f17822ceb4cf5533d6d8511b619f701048a4146 bf07e541f9de43272eab3a15019b3e35f8ba6227 | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = '.agents/memory/MEMORY.md .agents/memory/compile-the-finnish-messages-with-babel.md docs/tasks/19-remove-the-orientation-work-around.md docs/tasks/24-strip-location-data-from-uploaded-originals.md docs/third-party-notices.rst kasvimuseo/forms.py kasvimuseo/locale/fi/LC_MESSAGES/django.mo kasvimuseo/locale/fi/LC_MESSAGES/django.po kasvimuseo/management/__init__.py kasvimuseo/management/commands/__init__.py kasvimuseo/management/commands/strip_private_exif.py kasvimuseo/models.py kasvimuseo/templates/kasvimuseo/reports/planted-species.html kasvimuseo/templates/photologue/photo_detail.html kasvimuseo/tests/test_admin_forms.py kasvimuseo/tests/test_photo_orientation.py kasvimuseo/tests/test_templates.py ' && test "$(git rev-list --reverse 7f17822ceb4cf5533d6d8511b619f701048a4146..bf07e541f9de43272eab3a15019b3e35f8ba6227 | tr '\n' ' ')" = '91b8261804d78cfe67050a46ef13fae64e1b5d4e 5744b16a29f9c3a6df282b4d00ed8fda0bc384e1 bf07e541f9de43272eab3a15019b3e35f8ba6227 ' && echo ok

added=$(git diff 7f17822ceb4cf5533d6d8511b619f701048a4146 bf07e541f9de43272eab3a15019b3e35f8ba6227 | grep '^+' || true) && test -n "$added" && ! grep -nE '/home/|/tmp/claude|tinni|atom|hopeli|gogo|[.]kandev|[.]t3/' <<<"$added" && echo ok
